name: My shelf painting
shortDescription: A still-life shelf painting developed over several weeks as my professor taught the painting process, featuring a Mountain Dew can, playing card, and folding knife.
description: This painting was created over the course of several weeks and served as the piece my professor used to teach me the painting process.
The scene depicts a shelf with several objects arranged on it. The two most prominent subjects are a Mountain Dew can with a playing card in it and a folding knife.

details.Subject: Shelf still life
details.Prominent Objects: Mountain Dew can, playing card, and folding knife
